title: Fix fumadocs-mdx postinstall esbuild entry point error
body:
The `apps/site` postinstall script failed with esbuild error: `"The entry point 'source.config.ts' cannot be marked as external"`.

## Changes

- Upgraded `fumadocs-mdx` from `14.2.13` to `14.2.14` in `apps/site/package.json`

Version 14.2.14 (released 2026-04-14) includes bundling fixes that resolve the external entry point issue present in 14.2.13.
